violations.text: The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment placed a service call for dishwasher, all sanitizing moved to three bay. 3 bay sink sanitizer 75ppm. Establishment is to continue to use three bay sink until repair is made to dishwasher. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026

Sliced ham and sliced cheese was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Dates added during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026

Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Chemicals were labeled during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was shut down - contents were voluntarily disposed of. Establishment to send picture of cleaned and sanitized ice machine before resuming use. New Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2024

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was measured at 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. All items were sanitized in the three-bay sink. Mechanical dish washer to be professionally serviced. New Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2024
